name: Spicy Pork Rice Bowl with Pineapple-Broccoli Slaw & Lime Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ small pineapples

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, zest and juice limes. Divide between a small and large bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between the bowls.
Peel, halve, and mince onion. Add to the large bowl with the lime and cilantro. (Set large bowl aside for later use.)
Add yogurt and spices to the small bowl, then stir to combine the lime yogurt. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1.02 kg lean ground pork
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the large bowl, along with the broccoli slaw and salt, then toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) pkgs broccoli slaw
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, pork, and slaw between bowls. Top with lime yogurt and enjoy!
